product.name: Tawk
product.summary: Tawk has no channel directory and no invite links. A conversation has a name and a topic like anywhere else, but what actually addresses it is the one to ten tags its owner gave it. Some of those conversations want to be found. Some can only be entered by someone who already knows every tag.

conversationModels.name: Listed
conversationModels.headline: Findable by tag search
conversationModels.description: A listed conversation appears in search results with its name, topic, and tags visible. Match one of its tags and it shows up. Its owner can tighten that to exclusive matching, which means you have to supply every tag before it appears.
conversationModels.footnote: Anyone identified can join a listed conversation immediately. There is no request to approve and no invitation to wait for.

conversationModels.name: Unlisted
conversationModels.headline: Reachable only with the full tag set
conversationModels.description: An unlisted conversation is never named in search results. Search will tell you that hidden conversations match what you typed, and nothing more — not the name, not the topic, not a single tag. It opens only once you have supplied all of its tags and narrowed the hidden matches to one.
conversationModels.footnote: Tags that exist only on unlisted conversations are never offered as suggestions, so you cannot discover one by typing letters until something appears.

tagRules.title: What a tag looks like
constraints: Latin letters and numbers only, no spaces and no Unicode.
Case does not matter when tags are compared.
A hyphen can separate parts of a tag but cannot start or end one.
A conversation carries at least one tag and never more than ten.

identityNote.title: Everyone here has a name
identityNote.body: Tawk does not support anonymous participation. People sign in and post under a display name. Bots authenticate with a token and post under a visible bot profile. Both use the same membership and role model once they are inside a conversation, so a bot can own or administer a conversation exactly the way a person can.

entryPoints.label: Bot operator
entryPoints.description: Manage bot identities and their tokens.
